criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Real light and real dark, and the arc is measured rather than asserted. Slide 4 is the deck's one genuinely good idea drawn rather than written, the federal standards as a four-wire fence. Against that, three things a reader sees: slide 1's horizon is a razor-straight full-width seam that reads as two pictures stacked; slide 9's unworn pass, which carries half the close's argument, reads as a pale block; slide 8 is two grey plates on black and is the least made frame in the deck.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Attribution discipline is better than this account usually manages. claims.json's rejected block is exemplary and self-incriminating in the right direction. Two stretches keep this off 8: slide 9's dek compresses c25, and slide 7's headline carries a claim strip none of which supports the premise that a reader is judged by FMVSS.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: The round 4 fix is real and I credit it: slide 9's footer now reads AQ26002 and 49 CFR 552.3, matching slide 6's convention, and it turns an asserted right into something a reader can verify. It does not close the gap. 552.3 is where the rule is WRITTEN, not where the petition GOES, and on the frame the string runs inside one continuous 22px mono line straight into claim-id chrome. Slide 6's precedent works because Part 555 ALSO appears in a FILED UNDER row at display size.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns its swipe. On the standing dispute the reader's seat resolves it: the duplication is felt at 6, not at 5. Slide 5 buys the turn and the value arc's floor. Cut 6's first sentence, keep 5.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: 'One route has ruts. One started on September 3rd.' is a Texan sentence. The cost is the one TEXAS_VERNACULAR.md opens on: the drawn world is Edwards Plateau ranch country across nine of nine frames for a story about a robotaxi picking people up on city streets.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: dedupe_check returned nothing at threshold and a faint 0.21 against carousel no. 5, and the certification-not-driving distinction is enforced in the art rather than only in prose. Against it: eleven of eleven proposed tokens started inside dE 10 of recent decks and three shipped that way, and this is a fourth consecutive dark deck.
